facts.text: Jolene and her partner attended a yoga retreat where they experienced a sunrise that lit up the sky with bright colors.

evidence.quote: We had an awesome yoga retreat. The place was so peaceful and the view during yoga was amazing - the sunrise lit up the whole sky with bright colors.

facts.text: Jolene felt connected to nature and herself while practicing yoga with the backdrop of the sunrise.

evidence.quote: It was amazing! Doing yoga with that backdrop made me feel connected to nature and myself.

facts.text: Jolene and her partner took a trip that included a yoga retreat and a hike where they encountered a waterfall oasis.

evidence.quote: We had an awesome yoga retreat.
I remember taking a hike with my partner and coming across a waterfall oasis.

facts.text: Jolene and her partner experienced a sense of peace and gratitude during their yoga retreat.

evidence.quote: It was so beautiful, it made us feel so alive and grateful.
